concepts.learning_objective: Define colonialism and place the European 'Age of Colonialism' in its longer history.
Identify the political, economic, religious and scientific motives behind European expansion.
Evaluate the colonisers' claim of a 'civilising mission' against its actual results.

topics.title: Europeans in India: the Portuguese, the Dutch and the French

concepts.learning_objective: Describe India's economic standing in the world before European colonisation.
Explain how the Portuguese combined commercial control with religious persecution and faced resistance.
Compare the aims and fortunes of the Dutch and the French in India.

topics.title: Enter the British: from traders to rulers
topics.ncert_sections: Enter the British; From traders to rulers; The strategy of 'divide and rule'

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the 'divide and rule' strategy using the Battle of Plassey as an example.
Explain the Doctrine of Lapse and why it caused resentment.
Analyse how the subsidiary alliance transferred real power and costs to Indian rulers.

topics.title: From Paradise to Hell? Famines and the drain of wealth
topics.ncert_sections: From Paradise to Hell?; Devastating famines; The drain of India's wealth

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how colonial revenue and trade policies worsened famines in India.
Describe the drain of India's wealth and the scholars who documented it.

topics.title: Changing Landscapes: industries and governance
topics.ncert_sections: Decline of India's indigenous industries; Dismantling traditional governance structures

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how British trade policies ruined India's indigenous industries, especially textiles.
Describe India's village self-governance and how British rule and law replaced it.

topics.title: Changing Landscapes: education and the economy
topics.ncert_sections: Transforming Indian education; Reshaping economic structures to serve imperial needs

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the aims and effects of Macaulay's 1835 Minute on Indian Education.
Analyse how railways and the colonial economy served British interests and were paid for by Indians.

topics.title: Early resistance movements
topics.ncert_sections: Early Resistance Movements: Challenging Colonial Authority

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the Sannyasi-Fakir rebellion and its later influence.
Explain why tribal communities such as the Kols and Santhals rose against colonial rule.
Explain the causes and outcome of the Indigo Revolt.

topics.title: The Great Rebellion of 1857 and the legacy of colonialism
topics.ncert_sections: The Great Rebellion of 1857; The Legacy of European Colonialism in India

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the causes of sepoy discontent leading to the 1857 rebellion.
Explain the course, failure and significance of the Great Rebellion of 1857.
Evaluate the intended and unintended consequences of colonial rule in India.
